$comment: Validates _source/row-id-prefixes.json, the ID registry and the single source of truth for what a row-ID prefix means. Same role as _source/state-machines.schema.json.

Shape: the ID registry keys of the NDD review standard, appendix A.6 'List of JSON Keys' (array prefixes[]; required prefix, standsFor, meaning, section; no optional keys), plus the project keys, each of which starts with `x` (xOwner, xMirroredIn, xPending at an entry; xCollisionsSuppressed at the top).

The schema sees the SHAPE. row_id_prefixes_json_to_md.py checks what a schema cannot see: a prefix written twice, a prefix a tree uses and the registry lacks, a registration no tree uses, a `section` the owner tree does not define the rows in, and a mirror that holds an id the owner never defines.
title: The ID registry
description: Every row-ID prefix of the documentation: the English words its letters stand for, what one numbered row indexes, and where the rows are defined. docs/spec/_assets/tbl-row-id-prefixes.md is printed from it.

$comment.description: Notes for whoever edits this manuscript. JSON carries no comments, so the role declaration goes here. Not rendered.

xCollisionsSuppressed.description: A debt, not a permission: one prefix that stands in two trees with two meanings and is not repaired yet.

tree.description: A tree the generator walks: spec = docs/spec, records = docs/development-records, rules = docs/development-rules, review = docs/review (scoped: only the prefixes the registry gives it are counted).

text.description: One text per language, keyed by its BCP 47 language tag. en is the master; ja translates it.

prefix.description: The letters before the hyphen of a row ID.

standsFor.description: The English words the letters stand for. Empty when the documents do not say; never guessed.

meaning.description: One line saying what one numbered row indexes.

section.description: Where the owner tree defines the rows: a table id (T-010), the UID of the requirement an untitled table stands under (FR-083), or the path of a ledger or rules file. Empty only while xPending is true. The generator holds it against the walk.

xOwner.description: The tree that defines the rows.

xMirroredIn.description: Trees that only record rows the owner defines. The generator tests the claim id by id.

xPending.description: Registered before its rows exist. Suppresses the dead-registration error only.
